function myexp(x)
    sum = 1
    for k in 1:100
        sum += x^k / factorial(big(k))
    end
    return sum
end
myexp(1) - exp(1)

function myexp(x)
    sum = 0
    term = 1
    n = 1
    while sum + term != sum
        sum += term
        term *= x / n
        n += 1
    end
    sum
end
myexp(1) - exp(1)

plot(exp, xlims=(-1e-15, 1e-15), linestyle=:solid, label = "exp")

function myexpm1(x)
    sum = 0
    term = x
    n = 2
    while sum + term != sum
        sum += term
        term *= x / n
        n += 1
    end
    sum
end

function relerror(x, f, f_ref)
    fx = f(x)
    fx_ref = f_ref(x)
    max(abs(fx - fx_ref) / abs(fx_ref), 1e-17)
end
